method: Comment-stripped definitions, .style using closure, direct generated headers and own-header includes; independent namespace roots for quoted headers. External/generated include candidates require manual classification.

quoted_include_exceptions.reason: Existing external production-signing headers, unchanged in this merge; no private files read.

icon_method: String-aware comment removal and balanced icon blocks; same include roots and two-pass path lookup as codegen/style/parsed_file.cpp. Suffix modifiers checked, SVG XML parsed, PNG 1x/2x/3x dimensions checked. Does not execute Qt codegen or render SVG.
